scope: every Ship and C2-lite Workbench VM object/header/payload refill

content_oracle.source: one independent source-derived first-difference discriminator at the shared submit seam
content_oracle.descriptor: one target-owned immutable two-job source-probe/marker chain; the primary descriptor is distinct and submitted exactly once
content_oracle.initialization: make each source probe content-defined with its ordered marker, scan it against the current destination and retain the first unequal source byte
content_oracle.acceptance: the retained destination byte equals the retained source byte after the single primary submit
content_oracle.ordering: witness equality is tested before the 64-frame timeout
content_oracle.resubmission: the primary transfer is submitted exactly once

structural_form.route_rule: all four VM refills consume the common vm_object_load to vm_code_load_converged seam

covered_refill_paths: initial object load and TAILCALL object replacement through OBJ_SETUP
foreign-caller minimal header reload through BUF_ENSURE_MINE
foreign-caller complete header/literal reload through BUF_ENSURE_MINE
streamed payload and post-return window refill through WIN_ENSURE
claim_limit: The oracle proves destination content before consumption. It does not distinguish late delivery from target transfer malfunction.
